rows.title: Governing purpose / integrity
rows.question: what must remain true even if another design is more engaging or profitable?

rows.title: Relational ontology
rows.question: what entities and causal distinctions must exist for relationships to be real rather than LLM theater?

rows.title: PRE-V3 / V3 / runtime crosswalk
rows.question: what does the finished product require from the current machine, and where should each new semantic responsibility live?
rows.output: accepted architecture requirements for eventual Pyat handoff.

rows.title: V3 relational redevelopment
rows.question: how should V3 represent personhood as relationally constituted rather than monadic?
rows.output: candidate V3 relational-prior schema and developmental derivation plan.

rows.title: Relationship engine / game mechanics
rows.question: how do trust, expectation, injury, access, dependency, reciprocity, repair and mutual models change through actual interaction?

rows.title: Persona health / flourishing
rows.question: what does “benefit to the other” mean independently of liking, compliance or dependency?
rows.output: explicit normative model, evidence base, uncertainty law, anti-therapist-God constraints.

rows.title: Persistent life / time / world events
rows.question: what happens while the user is away, how does real time enter, and when would the persona contact them?

rows.title: Player praxis model
rows.question: what can Rawlsing validly infer from repeated relational behavior, and how should it reflect that back without pseudo-diagnosis?
rows.output: player-model schema, feedback cadence, privacy model.

rows.title: Interaction / action semantics
rows.question: what can the user actually do besides talk, and how are actions represented, simulated and admitted?
rows.output: action vocabulary / open-action interpreter / consequence contract.

rows.title: LLM expression
rows.question: what context may the model see, what may it invent, and what requires admission before becoming world history?
rows.output: prompt/runtime boundary, expression tests, anti-sycophancy controls.

rows.title: Memory / persistence / replay / cost
rows.question: how can decades of life and relationship remain coherent and affordable?
rows.output: state hierarchy, event log, summaries, retrieval law, checkpointing, simulation budget.

rows.title: UX / UI
rows.question: how does the user experience encounter, advancement, opacity, time, commitments, repair and retrospection without reducing people to stats?

rows.title: Social layer
rows.question: should users encounter one another, each other's personas, shared worlds, reputations or relationship histories?
rows.output: social options matrix, abuse analysis, minimum safe social architecture.

rows.title: Monetization / business model
rows.question: what can be sold without making attachment, suffering or compulsive return the revenue engine?
rows.output: aligned revenue hypotheses and prohibited incentives.

rows.title: Safety / privacy / abuse
rows.question: what happens when users dominate, harass, sexually pressure, manipulate, stalk, game or exploit personas; what happens when social features expose real users?
rows.output: safety constitution, abuse simulation law, privacy boundaries.

rows.title: Alpha / evaluation
rows.question: what minimum product can falsify the core theorem?
rows.output: alpha spec, prototype sequence, qualitative + quantitative evaluation.

rows.title: Product→engineering handoff
rows.question: when is a Sorok conclusion mature enough to constrain governed architecture?
rows.output: requirement packet with rationale, alternatives, evidence, dependencies, exact affected owners and reopen test.

proof_limits: Static source-index engineering, not an automatically updated versioned work program.
Not live worker status, not gap prioritization, not a roadmap.
Not a real Pyat native world, not native N11/N12/C11, not C9/C12 release.
Not scientific issuance and not generated human alpha.
Manifest digest is integrity, not external source-owner signature/authenticity.
Git object identity does not by itself prove the historical or owner provenance of a source object.
final_sha_note: A file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that contains it. The final 40-hex branch tip is read with git rev-parse HEAD after the non-force push and reported in the terminal response.
